name: Jar wine
summary: Homemade rice wine, drunk from a gourd through a long, narrow bamboo tube.
origin: Ban Ang. Vietnam Tourism, and the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s 2012 feature. The Tourism Information Technology Center also names fermented wine drunk from bamboo tubes in the villages.
howToEat: Share it from the gourd through the bamboo tube, with the village meal.
It is kept apart from leaf-yeast wine, corn wine, and rượu hoẵng, because the sources use those names too.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43. The night market sells unnamed specialty wines. That line is not this jar.
